# Antoine Boucher

> Software engineer in Montréal: platform work (Kubernetes, GitLab CI/CD, Terraform), interactive graphics (C++/OpenGL, Blender, Rust/wgpu), MCP tooling (uml-mcp) and DevSecOps teaching. This file indexes the CV, the articles and one documentation page per public repository; every blog page also exists as Markdown by appending `index.md` to its URL.

Language of this file: English. French version: https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/fr/llms.txt
Generated: 2026-11-12

## Projects documented from the source

[Catalog](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/) · [Catalog as Markdown](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/index.md). Each brief: languages (GitHub Linguist bytes), README start commands, components, architecture edges, API routes and files to read.

- [.dotfiles](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/dotfiles/index.md): These dotfiles collect the shell and editor setup I used across machines. The installer manages packages, configuration files and upstream projects.
- [AINewsTracker](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/ainewstracker/index.md): AINewsTracker combines financial-news ingestion, AI analysis and market backtesting in a Python web application.
- [another-install-script](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/another-install-script/index.md): another-install-script is a shell entry point for choosing system setup and container installations. Its structure separates the menu from the service definitions so that adding a service does not require putting every command in setup.sh.
- [antoinebou12](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/antoinebou12/index.md): This is the repository behind my GitHub profile README. It combines ordinary Markdown with images, embedded widgets and scheduled updates. There is no application server in the profile itself.
- [architecture](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/architecture/index.md): This archived repository stores a home-infrastructure diagram in several formats. Its architecture is a documentation workflow: editable sources produce diagrams that can be opened or viewed without a running application.
- [Artemis-N3DS](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/artemis-n3ds/index.md): Artemis-N3DS adapts Moonlight Embedded to the Nintendo 3DS family. It combines host discovery and pairing with a console-specific interface, input handling and video presentation. The New 3DS hardware path is a particular concern.
- [Artemis-Switch](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/artemis-switch/index.md): Artemis-Switch is a fork in the Moonlight streaming family. The host runs the game. The client receives compressed video and audio, renders frames and sends controller input back.
- [AudioTranscript](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/audiotranscript/index.md): AudioTranscript breaks a WAV recording into chunks around silence, sends each chunk to a recognition service and concatenates the results. The current implementation uses Amazon recognition, even though its docstrings still mention Google.
- [AuthLaravel](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/authlaravel/index.md): AuthLaravel is an access-control learning project with a Laravel backend and Vue pages delivered through Inertia. The route definitions show how authenticated users reach their dashboard and how administrators receive a different view.
- [BatchBacktesting](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/batchbacktesting/index.md): BatchBacktesting runs Python backtests across instruments and keeps strategy assumptions and outputs visible.
- [bloc](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/bloc/index.md): My bloc fork adds a Blender-facing workflow around S3 and MinIO storage. It preserves the upstream Blender-Cloud-Storage credit. The add-on translates object keys into a folder browser, then downloads assets before asking Blender to import them.
- [ChitUI](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/chitui/index.md): ChitUI places a browser interface in front of SDCP resin printers. A Python process serves the web assets, discovers printers on the local network and translates browser actions into printer communication.
- [ComfyUI-UML](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/comfyui-uml/index.md): ComfyUI-UML adds diagram-oriented nodes to ComfyUI. Text enters a workflow, a rendering backend turns it into an image, and the workflow can retain the source and viewer links alongside that output.
- [CV](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/cv/index.md): This website combines bilingual CV pages, structured resume data, LaTeX PDFs and a Hugo blog. A local script builds and validates both the CV and blog, then publishes them together from docs/ on main.
- [D2COpenAIPlugin](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/d2copenaiplugin/index.md): D2COpenAIPlugin is a FastAPI diagram service with a plugin manifest and an OpenAPI surface. Its implementation selects among PlantUML, Mermaid and Kroki paths based on the request’s diagram language.
- [DasherControl](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/dashercontrol/index.md): DasherControl brings homelab links and embedded applications into saved workspaces. Vue handles the interface, Rust and Rocket expose the API, and Diesel persists the layout in PostgreSQL. Docker control follows a separate path.
- [Dimension](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/dimension/index.md): Dimension is my Rust workspace for mathematics and graphics experiments. mathlib provides numerical building blocks; render uses them for CPU-side transforms and cameras before submitting graphics work through wgpu.
- [donneesqc-mcp](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/donneesqc-mcp/index.md): donneesqc-mcp is a fork exposing Québec and Montréal open-data operations through MCP tools. Its entry point registers the tool collection and starts an HTTP transport, leaving dataset access and geographic helpers in separate modules.
- [ESP32-7SEG](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/esp32-7seg/index.md): ESP32-7SEG connects an ESP32 clock display to network configuration and an HTTP interface. The firmware startup decides whether saved Wi-Fi settings can be reused or whether the device needs its setup path.
- [FlashGames](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/flashgames/index.md): FlashGames preserves small Flash games in a browser-facing collection. The page selects a SWF and hosts the Ruffle player. The game binary and the surrounding HTML interface remain separate pieces.
- [GithubSimpleFileDownloader](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/githubsimplefiledownloader/index.md): This archived extension attempted to add individual-file download controls to repository browsers. Its GitHub implementation shows the fragility of building an integration around another website’s DOM rather than a stable application interface.
- [GreenScreenVideotoAlphaPNGs](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/greenscreenvideotoalphapngs/index.md): GreenScreenVideotoAlphaPNGs separates video acquisition, frame extraction and chroma keying from final encoding. RGBA PNG frames are an intermediate output that can feed either the GIF path or an alpha-capable video codec.
- [hass_renpho](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/hass-renpho/index.md): hass_renpho is a fork of a Home Assistant integration for Renpho measurements. A shared coordinator refreshes cloud data and sensor entities expose that state. The repository warns that its old-app API path is no longer reliably working.
- [HDR-10bpp-Display-Test](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/hdr-10bpp-display-test/index.md): This display experiment loads image data into a GTK drawing area through Cairo. Viewer3.py makes the pixel representation explicit: channel samples are masked and packed into a uint32 buffer before creating an RGB30 surface.
- [ipc-toolkit](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/ipc-toolkit/index.md): ipc-toolkit provides geometric building blocks for contact-aware simulation. This fork contains collision meshes, broad-phase candidates, continuous collision detection and contact-related energies. An external simulation still owns its time stepping and solve loop.
- [jsonresume-theme-kendall](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/jsonresume-theme-kendall/index.md): This fork of the Kendall JSON Resume theme turns structured resume data into HTML. The renderer prepares presentation fields before handing the result to a Mustache template and the accompanying screen and print styles.
- [Kelly_RM](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/kelly-rm/index.md): Kelly_RM holds AlgoÉTS notebooks that simulate Kelly betting and estimate trade odds from RSI backtests to compute a Kelly fraction.
- [kroki-playground](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/kroki-playground/index.md): kroki-playground is a Next.js interface for editing text diagrams and previewing their output. Its server route validates the requested diagram type and format, encodes the source and fetches the rendered result from Kroki.
- [LegosTracker](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/legostracker/index.md): LegosTracker combines Rebrickable catalog exports, a Playwright scraper for BrickEconomy prices and notebooks that model LEGO set values.
- [linkshare](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/linkshare/index.md): linkshare is an archived Rails learning project for sharing links, commenting and voting. It renders pages on the server and includes account management and an administrative interface.
- [LLM2SVG](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/llm2svg/index.md): This LLM2SVG fork contains SVG dataset utilities and an evaluation-oriented scaffold. The visible implementation is useful for inspecting examples and constraints; it does not establish a completed or trained text-to-SVG model.
- [Maestro](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/maestro/index.md): This Maestro fork connects a React upload interface to a Spring backend and external music-conversion tools. Turning a score image into MIDI passes through an optical-recognition stage and an intermediate score representation.
- [marketwatch](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/marketwatch/index.md): marketwatch is an archived Python client for MarketWatch’s virtual trading game. It wraps login, game queries and simulated order operations. These are game interactions, not connections to a brokerage account.
- [MarkokChainMonteCarlo](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/markokchainmontecarlo/index.md): AlgoÉTS notebooks that simulate AAPL prices with Monte Carlo paths and a Markov chain, then backtest a strategy built on them against buy and hold.
- [MediaBoxDockerCompose](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/mediaboxdockercompose/index.md): MediaBoxDockerCompose brings several homelab services together in Docker Compose. Service definitions, shared filesystem paths and network connections describe how they work together.
- [MistubaVideo](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/mistubavideo/index.md): MistubaVideo is an ETSim repository for video-related work with Mitsuba.
- [nova-backtest](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/nova-backtest/index.md): nova-backtest is an archived fork of a strategy-backtesting framework. The core class selects an exchange client, loads a historical interval and manages a simulated bankroll and position constraints.
- [novatorem](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/novatorem/index.md): This novatorem fork builds music-status widgets from provider data. A Flask orchestrator handles rendering, while Spotify and Last.fm have separate modules. Album artwork supplies both an image and colors for the SVG.
- [nxsand](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/nxsand/index.md): nxsand is a falling-sand simulation for Switch with a desktop development target. Materials live in an integer grid. Simulation passes update that grid, and a separate rendering path turns material identifiers into the displayed image.
- [Pan-Tilt-Controller](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/pan-tilt-controller/index.md): This archived pan-tilt controller connects a desktop interface to a serial-controlled positioning unit. The implementation mixes a Qt event loop with pyserial commands and keeps the requested pan and tilt positions in global state.
- [PolyFEMBlenderPlugin](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/polyfemblenderplugin/index.md): Blender 4.2 add-on that exports meshes and physics settings to a PolyFEM JSON file, runs PolyFEM through Docker and imports the results.
- [RawAnalyser](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/rawanalyser/index.md): RawAnalyser is an older Python image-analysis experiment for clipping, channel values, gamma and vignetting. Its input assumptions are visible in the implementation, including a fixed raw frame shape and regions selected through a JSON file.
- [retroarch-web-games](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/retroarch-web-games/index.md): retroarch-web-games is an archived container setup around a web build of RetroArch. The repository combines browser runtime files with scripts and container assembly. Hosting the player and supplying game content are separate concerns.
- [Salary](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/salary/index.md): Salary extracts Canadian salary guide PDFs and Job Bank wage tables with Python, then compares pay by job, province and region in notebooks.
- [Serilog.Sinks.SentrySDK](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/serilog-sinks-sentrysdk/index.md): Serilog.Sinks.SentrySDK connects a .NET logging pipeline to the Sentry SDK. Its sink converts structured log events for Sentry, so application call sites can keep using Serilog.
- [SimilityVectorEmbedding](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/similityvectorembedding/index.md): Jupyter notebooks that embed a movie catalog and compare pgvector, Qdrant, BM25, Neo4j and a local LLM for finding similar films.
- [Simulateur](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/simulateur/index.md): Simulateur is a Django platform where admins script market scenarios and teams trade simulated stocks with live WebSocket prices.
- [sm64coopdx-switch-N3DS](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/sm64coopdx-switch-n3ds/index.md): This fork explores Switch and New 3DS targets for sm64coopdx. Shared game and co-op code sit above platform-specific graphics, audio and input. The platform probe is a smaller executable with a narrower purpose than the full game.
- [Sport-Arbitrage](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/sport-arbitrage/index.md): Sport-Arbitrage is a one-page calculator that checks odds from two betting sites for an arbitrage and computes stakes and guaranteed profit.
- [SpringBootFilesUploader](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/springbootfilesuploader/index.md): SpringBootFilesUploader is a Kotlin and Spring backend with a file-upload path that separates binary storage from document metadata. A file identifier returned to the client connects those two representations during download.
- [switch-wifi](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/switch-wifi/index.md): switch-wifi is a Switch network dashboard with a Borealis interface. It separates portable metric calculations from the console application so that host tests can exercise the core without requiring the Switch toolchain.
- [TCH099](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/tch099/index.md): TCH099 is a teaching-oriented web project that combines static frontend pages with PHP API handlers. The route file makes the boundary visible: some paths return HTML files, while others dispatch to server-side scripts.
- [TradingViewBuilder](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/tradingviewbuilder/index.md): TradingViewBuilder collects Pine Script indicators and strategies (EMA, MACD, RSI, Bollinger Bands, RVI …) to paste into TradingView.
- [TrueMapData](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/truemapdata/index.md): TrueMapData reads TrueMap and GelSight height maps, processes them and exports visual, surface and mesh-oriented results.
- [uml-mcp](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/uml-mcp/index.md): uml-mcp exposes diagram tools to MCP clients. The client supplies diagram source and options; the server validates and routes the request to rendering services, then returns diagram results and useful editor links.
- [uml-skill](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/uml-skill/index.md): uml-skill packages diagram-writing instructions and a small Python helper. It is a skill bundle, not an MCP server or an image-generation model. The helper can produce a Kroki URL from diagram source.
- [WearBlender](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/wearblender/index.md): Example Blender files showing edge wear, scratches, rotated normal maps, flow maps and painted wear with shaders and geometry nodes.
- [WearMachine](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/wearmachine/index.md): STEP, STL, DXF and drawing files for a small sliding-wear rig: rail, pusher, weight holders and GelSight sample holders.
- [WearSurfacesDatasets](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/wearsurfacesdatasets/index.md): GelSight surface maps of materials worn under controlled grit, load and distance, packed as Parquet and WebDataset, with alignment tools and a WebGPU viewer.
- [WearTrailsExperiments](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/weartrailsexperiments/index.md): three.js and Ammo.js experiments that turn rigid-body contact, traction and sliding into wear, sliding-distance and flow maps on a ground texture.
- [WordsEnigma](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/wordsenigma/index.md): WordsEnigma is a fork with separate Redwood web and API workspaces. Its data model links users, languages, word banks, games and individual guesses. GraphQL services translate application operations into Prisma database calls.
- [Workshop1](https://antoineboucher.info/CV/blog/projects/notes/workshop1/index.md): Workshop1 is an AlgoETS notebook series that moves from Python fundamentals and APIs to pandas, charts and an EMA exercise.
